summary: Preserve accepted description when blocking a ticket while retaining reason history and clearing active execution claims

delivery.outcome: Blocking a ticket preserves every nonempty accepted description and existing inputs/outputs, retains block reasons in history and explicit notes, clears active execution claims, and preserves legacy empty-description presentation.
nonGoals: No global GitHub managed-body roundtrip redesign; existing issue341 owns it
No foreign allocator280 changes or migration

architecture.decision: Keep block_ticket as the shared SDK lifecycle transition; write synthetic blocker description only when no accepted description exists and preserve existing update/history/note machinery.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded source change through independent protected delivery; never overwrite already recovered ticket descriptions.

validation.evidence: Pending native verification of nonempty and repeated blocking, reason history, output preservation and existing empty-description behavior.
Pending required governance, all8protected checks and independent exact-head review/merge.
